1995 Observer IGOs Explanation The purpose of observer status for international intergovernmental organizations in the WTO is to enable these organizations to follow discussions therein on matters of direct interest to them. The guidelines on observer status for  international organizations are found in WT/L/161 ,  Annex 3.
